name: GitLab
description: Built-in GitLab plugin for gitlab.com and self-hosted instances. Uses local glab sign-ins automatically, or add an instance URL and api-scope token (prioritized) for 107 operations across issues, MRs, reviews, repos, CI, and search. Each token is injected only for its own instance.
whenToUse: Use for gitlab.com, company, or self-hosted GitLab (use GitHub for github.com): issues, MRs, reviews, repos, CI, logs, releases, search, and archives. Uses local glab sign-ins automatically or an added token. Use mr_card to publish, display, or follow an MR.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 107 GitLab operations across issues, merge_requests, project_path, commits, events, search, projects, users, pipelines, jobs, discussions, approvals, draft_notes, reactions, groups, environments, wiki, snippets, releases, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitLab operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Project operations require project_path such as group/subgroup/project, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin. With multiple instances, set instance to a connection ID or instance URL; omission uses the default connection. Avatar and _links fields are removed by default; set raw=true for original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Repository archive downloads require top-level save_dir in ghost_call. upload_project_file requires user media in top-level attachments.

mr_card.description: Show a MR card in Cindy. Before publishing, pass project_path, head and base, optionally with commits and files. After this task successfully publishes, pass published=true and mr, plus card_id if available. On supported hosts the card starts follow-up for a non-draft MR when the saved setting is enabled. Pass following=false if the user asked to publish only. Omit published when viewing an existing MR. If follow_state is present, the card owns follow-up and you must not create another schedule. active means running, paused means paused, stopped means ended, failed means setup failed, and unverified means the state could not be confirmed. On older hosts, use todo only when follow_state is absent. Before creating a schedule yourself, pass claim_follow=true and require follow_claimed=true. existing_task points to the task already responsible, and the card link only navigates there. Report only verified operations via renamed and following. Refresh via card_id and use to_latest when notifying.

mr_follow_settings.description: Read the same auto-rename, auto-follow and follow-model preferences used by MR cards. Returns settings without showing a card, creating a task or starting follow-up; preferences are not proof that following is active. Use after opening a MR in IM too, then create and verify follow-up with the mr workflow. A read failure means unknown, not disabled.
